ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 44 / OppVR64] Opportunity cannot move from Booking Verification back to Qualification/Solutioning/Negotiation once BV = Pass. Rebuilt per IRM correction (was a generic regression check).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(StageName),
ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Booking Verification'),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation') ),
ISPICKVAL(Deal_Validation__c, 'Pass') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Stage regression is not allowed. You cannot move an Opportunity backwards after Booking Verification is complete.
